title: lallemantia canescens
intro: Lallemantia canescens, commonly known as "blue pimpernel", is a flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lallemantia canescens include its ability to reduce fever, relieve coughs, and act as an expectorant to help clear mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
